posts.title: NUTS HEL 14km trail run
posts.description: Distance: 14km Total time: 01:21:15 Overall 22/259 Gender 19/110 Age group 3/20 Fun & intense run on wet trails & rocks in Helsinki Central Park. Start and finish line in Eläintarha stadium. Hadn’t really prepared for trail running at all, no trail runs for the past 2-3 years. But I found my old inov-8 trail shoes, so why not!

posts.title: Björn Borg Helsinki Half Marathon
posts.description: Distance: 21,1km Total time: 01:39:07 Avg pace: 4:38 km/h About 2 years ago in Marbella I got 1:38:28, so this one was less than a minute slower. The training has been quite limited during these 2 years (except for last year, with almost full bike focus in the limited time I had), so this was more like a baseline measurement event than a true race with proper preparation. The next goal is a faster half marathon in summer 2027, probably in Salzburg. Goal ≈ 1:33.

posts.title: Saimaa Cycling Tour 2026
posts.description: Distance: 300km Total time: 09:35:47 Moving avg: 32,9 km/h A beautiful night ride (start at 8 PM). Our group consisted of 7 riders, 2 of which were exceptionnally strong riders who stayed at the front for the whole 300km. We had two fairly quick bottle stops. Had no issues on the fitness front, but suffered a bit from stiff neck, tingling in the fingers of left hand, and had very sore legs afterwards for couple of days. Training leading to this event was very limited and much lower than what I would have preferred, but life got in the way. My longest ride for the last year was 130km (solo ride, 30 km/h avg), and the number of rides of 100km or longer was 2. Nevertheless, having 100% pullers made this a very pleasant ride.
